name: Mother
source:
38 years old. A full-time housewife.

Married at a young age, she has lived a life with no inconveniences. She looks younger than her age for this reason, but has a lustrous body commensurate with her age.

She is about 10 years older than her husband, and it has been several years since they stopped having a night life, so she has a lot on her mind, although she does not say so.

Her personality is quiet, reserved, and calm. However, she is not good at improvising and blushes when she gets into trouble.
